_law: DARKITH.md MUST #36 — NO OFF-SCHEDULE DWELL. The Operator sets the schedule; an agent never invents a tolerance.
_what: Dwell is measured from git, not guessed: unpushed_seconds = now - committer time of the oldest commit origin does not have; dirty_seconds = now - mtime of the oldest dirty path (a floor).
_why: A gate that answers only yes/no (is the board pushed?) is blind to LATENCY. Work can be 'about to be pushed' indefinitely while every gate stays green, and the stall accumulates as real cost: missed deadlines, stalled parallel tabs, broken commitments.
_remedy: unpushed_seconds breach -> run tools/board_pulse.sh. dirty_seconds breach -> commit the work. Dwell is the defect, not the symptom.
